WITH filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
),
store_sales_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
           ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
           ss_net_profit AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
           sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
           sr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN filtered_dates ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
ssr AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_id,
           SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_sales_returns
    JOIN store ON store_sales_returns.store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s_store_id
),
catalog_sales_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
           cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
           cs_net_profit AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
           cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
           cr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
    JOIN filtered_dates ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
csr AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_sales_returns
    JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_sales_returns.page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
web_returns_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT wr_item_sk,
           wr_order_number,
           wr_return_amt,
           wr_net_loss
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN filtered_dates ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
web_sales_date_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws_item_sk,
           ws_order_number,
           ws_web_site_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
web_sales_other AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws_item_sk,
           ws_order_number,
           ws_web_site_sk
    FROM web_sales
    LEFT JOIN filtered_dates ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_date_sk IS NULL
),
web_sales_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
           ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
           ws_net_profit AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
           wr.wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
           wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM web_returns_filtered wr
    JOIN web_sales_date_filtered ws
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
           wr.wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
           wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss
    FROM web_returns_filtered wr
    JOIN web_sales_other ws
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
),
wsr AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT web_site_id,
           SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(profit) AS profit,
           SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_sales_returns
    JOIN web_site ON web_sales_returns.wsr_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY web_site_id
),
x AS (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM wsr
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT channel,
           id,
           sales,
           returns,
           profit
    FROM x
    ORDER BY channel, id
    LIMIT 100
) limited
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
